rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for deliberately breathing air in.

example.english: After running, I inhale first—don't rush to talk.
example.traditional: 我跑完步先吸氣，唔好咁急住講嘢。
example.jyutping: ngo5 paau2 jyun4 bou6 sin1 kap1 hei3 m4 hou2 gam3 gap1 zyu6 gong2 je5

rows.note: Use this for inhaling smoke, fumes, aerosols, or another substance, especially in casual speech.

example.english: Whenever I inhale smoke, my throat feels awful.
example.traditional: 我一吸啲煙，個喉嚨就好辛苦。
example.jyutping: ngo5 jat1 kap1 di1 jin1 go3 hau4 lung4 zau6 hou2 san1 fu2

rows.note: Use this more formal or technical verb when describing gas, smoke, or medication entering the lungs.

example.english: During the lung-function test, you have to inhale the specified gas.
example.traditional: 做肺功能測試時，要吸入指定氣體。
example.jyutping: zou6 fai3 gung1 nang4 cak1 si3 si4 jiu3 kap1 jap6 zi2 ding6 hei3 tai2
